en.bdb: In the company of the swans -

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਸੁਥਾਉਂ ਸੁਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: maanak motee maanasar niramal neer suthaau(n) suha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Pure water, rubies and pearls adorn into the Manasarovar (lake).

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਥੁ ਬਣੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: ha(n)s va(n)s nihachal matee sa(n)gat pa(n)gat saath bana(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The family of the swans is of steadfast wisdom and they all live in groups and lines.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਵਧੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: maanak motee chog chug maan mahat aana(n)dh vadha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: They enhance their prestige and delight by picking up rubies and pearls.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਂਉ ਨਿਥਾਉ ਨਿਨਾਉ ਹੈ ਹੰਸਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: kaa(n)au nithaau ninaau hai ha(n)saa(n) vich udhaas hova(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The crow there remains nameless, shelterless and dejected,

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ ਅਭਖੁ ਭਖ ਵਣ ਵਣ ਅੰਦਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhakh abhakh abhakh bhakh van van a(n)dhar bharam bhava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The inedible it considers edible and to edible inedible, and goes on wandering from forest to forest.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਣਿ ਤਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun tan a(n)dhar man thir na raha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: So long as a person listening to the word of Guru in the holy congregation does not stabilise his body and mind.
His stony gate (of wisdom) is not unlocked.
